headline: S&P 500 down 6 straight, Anthropic -6% pre-market, VIX above VIX3M, Nasdaq futures lower
stance: Thursday's selloff hit every S&P 500 sector, and Nasdaq futures are lower again. UMich final at 10:00 is today's only US data.

news.head: Anthropic -6% pre-market after 17% debut
news.body: ANT rose 17% in its first session Thursday. Down nearly 6% pre-market as AI shares slide (~4:28am ET).

news.head: AMD closes down over 7% on short-seller report
news.body: Report alleges AMD firmware reached a blacklisted Chinese firm. AMD says it complies with US law (~7:08pm ET).

news.head: California AG subpoenas Nvidia on China chips
news.body: Probe of chip diversion to China (~6:21pm ET). Commerce approved 879,000+ AI chips for Chinese buyers, a lawmaker says (~7:53pm ET).

news.head: Intuit outlook disappoints
news.body: Downbeat guidance adds to pressure on legacy software names (~5:53pm ET).

implications: Paulson joined the hike camp Thursday night with the S&P 500 down 6 sessions. FOMC is Dec 9; no Fed relief before then.
Spec Nasdaq 100 longs sit at the 89th %ile into an AI selloff. That is where funds are, not a sell signal.

watch.head: UMich final sentiment, 10:00
watch.body: Final November read on household inflation expectations.

watch.head: FX option expiries, 10:00 cut
watch.body: USD/JPY 160.00 ($900m) vs 159.62 Thursday's close. EUR/USD 1.1000 (EUR 1.97bn) (~2:52am ET).

watch.head: Iran oil exports
watch.body: Iran preparing to restart crude exports as the US says it will tighten its naval blockade (~4:00am ET).

watch.head: PCE and GDP, Nov 25, 8:30
watch.body: Next inflation data before the Dec 9 FOMC.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Paulson said the Fed has more tightening to do (~11:08pm ET). Her prepared remarks gave no rate steer.
Gold slid toward $3,600 Thursday (~7:07pm ET). Oil rose overnight on Houthi attacks on Saudi targets (~12:51am ET).
Japan CPI 2.3% vs 2.5% expected (~6:31pm ET). UK October retail sales +0.7% m/m vs 0.0% expected (~2:00am ET).
sections.positioning: Spec 2y Treasury longs 93rd %ile, 15 weeks, standing. Spec euro longs 1st %ile, 7 weeks at the extreme.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: All 11 S&P 500 sectors fell Thursday, 10 by more than 1% (~6:11pm ET). Cybersecurity was the lone gainer group.
VIX closed above VIX3M Thursday. Near-term hedges now cost more than 3-month protection.
Nasdaq futures lower pre-market (~4:39am ET). Asian tech fell overnight after the Nasdaq's 2%+ drop (~2:23am ET).
sections.positioning: Spec Russell 2000 longs 99th %ile, 6 weeks, standing. Spec VIX shorts 10th %ile, 5 weeks.

single_name.note: Score 5, two sessions on the screen. Insider buy filed Nov 18. Trades above its 200-day line.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: CP spread 13bp wider Thursday, SOFR-OIS 2bp Wednesday. Strain shows in corporate paper, not bank funding.
Listed BDCs 0.88x NAV, median, at Thursday's close.
RRP near zero at $0.4bn. Reserves now absorb any further drain.
sections.positioning: No credit COT extreme. Dealer IG inventory mid-range, 73rd %ile of 3 years.
